faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Resume Booster

whatDoIGet.question: What do I get with Resume Booster?
whatDoIGet.answer: You get a comprehensive analysis including AI-ATS optimized bullet point rewrites, stronger action verb suggestions, keyword recommendations for your industry, and red flags that AI screeners and recruiters might notice. Everything is written in direct, actionable language.

howLong.question: How long does the analysis take?
howLong.answer: Your resume analysis is generated instantly after payment. You will see your results on the success page within seconds.

fileFormats.question: What file formats do you accept?
fileFormats.answer: We accept PDF files, Word documents (DOCX), and plain text. Simply upload your resume file or paste your resume text directly into the input field.

subscription.question: Is this a subscription?
subscription.answer: No. Resume Booster is a one-time payment of $25. There are no subscriptions, recurring charges, or upsells.

share.question: Can I share my analysis with others?
share.answer: Yes! After your analysis is complete, you can copy a shareable link to send to mentors, career coaches, or anyone you want feedback from.

whoWrites.question: Who writes the feedback?
whoWrites.answer: The feedback is generated by AI trained to think like a recruiter. It focuses on what actually matters in the hiring process, not generic career advice.

dataStorage.question: Do you store my resume data?
dataStorage.answer: No. We do not store or collect your resume content. Your resume is processed in real-time to generate your analysis, and then immediately discarded. We never retain your personal information.

vsChatGPT.question: Why is this better than ChatGPT or resume templates?
vsChatGPT.answer: Resume Booster uses AI to simulate how modern AI-powered ATS systems scan resumes, with a 5-category weighted scoring system, 14 industry-specific templates, and recruiter-calibrated feedback. Unlike ChatGPT, you get consistent 10-section structured output without prompt engineering. Unlike templates, we provide personalized rewrites, LinkedIn analysis, and job description alignment. Your data is immediately discarded—never used for training.
